combo2.title: Pre-Prep Mitsurugi to Clown Crew Fusion Pivot
combo2.description: A versatile hybrid route initiated by Pre-Preparation of Rites, fetching Ame no Habakiri no Mitsurugi and Mitsurugi Mirror. Loops the Mitsurugi Ritual core through Saji, Aramasa, Kusanagi, and Futsu no Mitama to establish recursive Tribute advantage, before smoothly pivoting into the Clown Crew engine with Clown Crew Diabolo, Clown Crew Fiends, Clown Crew Biancaviso, and Clown Crew Dristy for high-pressure disruption and card economy.
